summary: Part of the Survival RPG adventure games, explore this 2d retro pixel world.
description: ** Remastered version ** Survival RPG 2: Ruins of Lost Temple is the sequel of the first retro game: Survival RPG 1: Lost Treasure. An even stranger adventure awaits you! It is a free 2d classic RPG retro game (role playing games). It is a survival RPG adventure game that combines puzzles, mine, craft and exploration of different things in order to succeed in your quest in this 2d fantasy retro style pixel art universe. On the first game, you were exploring to find a lost treasure. After many combats, be a forager, crafting and discovery, you came back victorious. Now, you heard rumors from a stranger mentioning a magical artifact that lies among the ruins of a lost temple. So you decide to embark on a new journey full of adventures in this retro games leading you to a mysterious temple lost in the jungle. In order to succeed, you will have to explore strange countries with desert, jungle, forest, dungeon, caves in order to complete quests, solve puzzles, help other characters, become a forager expert and gather, mine and craft many things and fight monsters in this retro RPG game (role playing game). Adventures await you. Features: - 7 story chapters that will bring you to the artifact. - Exploration of more than 30 dungeons, caverns, jungles, temples and huts. - More than 180 things to gather, mine and craft - Multiple roleplay quests and characters to help you in your strange journey. - 70 crafting recipes that you will unlock during your adventure and exploration. - Craft tools to help you - Cut trees with an axe - Use shovel for different tasks - Create candles or lantern to see in dark dungeons - Use pickaxes to gather different minerals - And many more... - Discover hidden items - Forage for food and become the forager expert - Find hidden treasures with treasure maps - Fight more than 35 different monsters and bosses - Explore and solve multiple puzzles - Classic retro old school RPG style - Free RPG games (role playing games) Enjoy Survival RPG: Ruins of Lost Temple. A free 2d retro RPG adventure game, explore strange and foreign countries, forest, jungle, temple and dungeon, gather, forager, craft things to help you survive and find the artifact!
